provenance.movement_reasoning: Mara's work materials remain visibly active at the dining table, while commuting items reset around the entry after trips. Kitchenware cycles through meals, sink, rack, and cupboards; reading and television create sofa clusters. Exercise, grooming, laundry, cleaning, and medication each leave their associated items in practical nearby places, with tidy-up restoring the more orderly defaults.
